pseudos.text: In May 2026, in the Visayan Islands, Philippines, Kepco SPC Power Unit 2 tripped off-grid, and since May, 11 generators have failed. Officials ordered emergency load shedding to prevent overloading of 230 kV transmission lines.
Starting from May 2026, 11 generators have failed in the Visayan Islands, Philippines. The Visayan grid was placed on red alert, and over 950 megawatts of capacity became unavailable.
In the Visayan Islands, Philippines, in midsummer 2026, seasonal high temperatures increased electricity demand, narrowing operating margins, and the risk of rolling blackouts increased.

news.title: Rotational blackout risks rise in Visayas amid power crunch
news.description: The Philippines grid operator placed the Visayas under red alert after Kepco SPC Power's Unit 2 tripped offline, leaving more than 950 megawatts unavailable alongside other long-running plant outages. Eleven generators have failed since May began, while seasonal heat drove demand into a thin operating margin. Officials ordered emergency load shedding to keep a critical 230-kilovolt transmission line from overloading.
